problem: If the sum of the first $50$ terms of an arithmetic series is ${S}_{50}=600,$ and the last term is ${a}_{50}=21.8,$ then the first term of the series is ${a}_{1}=${{field-1}}.
worked_solution:
We are given the last term of our series. So, to find the first term, we use the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series in the form

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{N}{2}({a}_{1}+{a}_{N}),
$$

where ${a}_{1}$ is the first term, ${a}_{N}$ is the last term, and $N$ is the number of terms.

Substituting ${a}_{50}=21.8$, $N=50$, and ${S}_{N}=600$ into the formula above and solving for ${a}_{1}$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}600 & =\frac{50}{2}({a}_{1}+21.8) \\ 600 & =25({a}_{1}+21.8) \\ \frac{600}{25} & ={a}_{1}+21.8 \\ 24 & ={a}_{1}+21.8 \\ {a}_{1} & =2.2.\end{aligned}
$$
